scenario: `then ... within <dur>` whose then-pattern has its own where-clause — the where folds into the then-pattern's match per RLOW.5.6, not into the temporal test.
rules_ds:
schema A scope ttl 1_h:
    ts: Time

schema B scope ttl 1_h:
    ts: Time
    state: String

rule r:
    A
    then B b within 5_s where b.state == "on"
->
    log info "x"
